command:
python3 - <<'PY'
path='mux.go'
s=open(path).read()
old='''		frame := &muxFrame{cmd: muxCmdPSH, sid: st.id, priority: st.priority, payload: remaining[:n]}
		st.sess.sendMu.Lock()
		st.sess.appendToStream(st, frame)
		st.sess.sendMu.Unlock()
		st.sendMu.Unlock()

		st.sess.signalSend()
		remaining = remaining[n:]'''
new='''		frame := &muxFrame{cmd: muxCmdPSH, sid: st.id, priority: st.priority, payload: remaining[:n]}
		st.sess.sendMu.Lock()
		st.sess.appendToStream(st, frame)
		st.sess.sendMu.Unlock()
		st.sendMu.Unlock()

		atomic.AddUint64(&DefaultSnmp.MuxBytesSent, uint64(n))
		st.sess.signalSend()
		remaining = remaining[n:]'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)

old='''	atomic.AddUint64(&DefaultSnmp.MuxFramesSent, 1)
	if f.cmd == muxCmdPSH {
		atomic.AddUint64(&DefaultSnmp.MuxBytesSent, uint64(len(f.payload)))
	}
	return nil'''
new='''	atomic.AddUint64(&DefaultSnmp.MuxFramesSent, 1)
	return nil'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w mux.go && go build ./... && timeout 25 go test -race -run 'TestMux' -count=1 -timeout 20s . 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "EXIT: $?"
